titulo: Let’s review: My past and future
objetivo: Talk about past experiences, future plans, advice, comparisons, and real-life situations.

memo.t: I’m going to travel next year.
memo.es: Voy a viajar el próximo año.

memo.t: The city is busier than my town.
memo.es: La ciudad es más concurrida que mi pueblo.

memo.t: My goal is to speak English fluently.
memo.es: Mi meta es hablar inglés con fluidez.

parejas.a: Tell me about a great experience.
parejas.b: I went to Chiapas last year. It was amazing.

parejas.a: What are your plans for next year?
parejas.b: I’m going to look for a new job.

parejas.a: I want to visit Mexico. Any advice?
parejas.b: You should visit Oaxaca. The food is the best!

parejas.a: Is your city bigger than Oaxaca?
parejas.b: Yes, it’s much bigger and busier.
Thank you! It was a great experience.

quiz.t: Next year I’m ___ to study in Toronto.
quiz.h: El próximo año voy a estudiar en Toronto.
Deberías reservar tu hotel con tiempo.
Toronto es más frío que la Ciudad de México.

quiz.t: The best ___ is to ask for help.
